policy: Exclude only tests requiring syntax absent from the frozen 2026 edition. Keep runtime/builtin-only proposals when their original source uses standard 2026 syntax; their runtime and module-resolution assertions are not executed by this parser audit.

excludedFeatures.decorators: Stage 2.7 in the TC39 active proposals list on 2026-10-21; decorator syntax is absent from the frozen ECMAScript 2026 ClassDefinition and ClassElement productions. Sources: https://github.com/tc39/proposals#stage-27 ; https://tc39.es/ecma262/2026/multipage/ecmascript-language-functions-and-classes.html#sec-class-definitions
excludedFeatures.explicit-resource-management: Stage 4, expected publication 2027 in TC39 finished proposals; using/await using declarations are absent from the frozen ECMAScript 2026 Declaration and ForInOfStatement productions. Source: https://github.com/tc39/proposals/blob/main/finished-proposals.md ; https://tc39.es/ecma262/2026/multipage/ecmascript-language-statements-and-declarations.html
excludedFeatures.import-defer: Stage 3; import defer and import.defer syntax is absent from the frozen ECMAScript 2026 ImportDeclaration and ImportCall productions. Sources: https://github.com/tc39/proposal-defer-import-eval ; https://tc39.es/ecma262/2026/multipage/ecmascript-language-scripts-and-modules.html#sec-imports
excludedFeatures.source-phase-imports: Stage 3; import source and import.source syntax is absent from the frozen ECMAScript 2026 ImportDeclaration and ImportCall productions. Sources: https://github.com/tc39/proposal-source-phase-imports ; https://tc39.es/ecma262/2026/multipage/ecmascript-language-scripts-and-modules.html#sec-imports
excludedFeatures.source-phase-imports-module-source: ESM Phase Imports is Stage 2.7; this feature depends on Source Phase Imports syntax, which is absent from the frozen ECMAScript 2026 edition. Sources: https://github.com/tc39/proposal-esm-phase-imports ; https://github.com/tc39/proposal-source-phase-imports

decorators.reason: The active TC39 proposals list is the current status authority; an older individual proposal README may still describe an earlier stage.

explicit-resource-management.reason: The finished proposals list gives expected publication year 2027. Stage 4 alone does not imply inclusion in the already frozen 2026 edition.

import-bytes.reason: The proposal uses existing import attributes, for example with { type: 'bytes' }, rather than adding a lexical token or syntactic production. The parser audit does not perform host loading or inspect the imported value.

import-text.reason: The proposal assigns host semantics to an existing import attribute type value. Its import syntax is standard import-attributes syntax; module loading is not run.

immutable-arraybuffer.reason: The proposal adds ArrayBuffer APIs and execution semantics. Calling a proposed method uses existing member/call grammar, so its source remains useful as a positive syntax input.

nonextensible-applies-to-private.reason: The proposal changes when adding a private field throws at execution time. Its class/private-field syntax already exists in the 2026 edition. Runtime exception expectations do not change source parsing.
